edition: Unofficial Zork Creative Natural Play Glulx
player_outcomes: ordinary COOK language reaches the existing bounded Kitchen preparation and heating mechanics instead of failing as an unknown word
every player-visible Kitchen range name uses parser-typeable cast iron wording
deliberately strange COOK targets receive physical authored refusals rather than an unknown verb
addressed actor commands can naturally name real objects carried by that actor instead of searching only the adventurer's pockets
MARA, TAKE PACK resolves the real pack after Mara herself is carrying it while player theft remains blocked by the pack action
repeated Mara pack commands report actual custody and never falsely relocate the camp to the Dam after she has based it in the Attic
Mara's first House threshold line renders without a Glulxe control glyph
TIE UP MARA WITH ROPE and TIE MARA WITH ROPE stay inside Mara's authored character instead of falling into vanilla actor prose with the hard-coded masculine him
attempted physical restraint becomes durable Mara history and ends automatic following rather than disappearing after the refusal
SEND MARA AFTER TROLL WITH AXE is accepted as natural player language despite the legacy parser's two-noun syntax ceiling and is refused in Mara's own voice
combat-order language records attempted coercion without making Mara a controllable combat unit
Mara distinguishes an alert troll from the real absurd-alternate bound troll and may enter the now-passable Troll Room only after that physical consequence exists
Mara remembers the first time she witnesses the living bound troll instead of treating the cross-release consequence as invisible
Mara's manipulation fallbacks share one proper-name person renderer so absurd verbs cannot regress to the Mara or generic masculine actor prose
personhood refusals are scoped to Mara as the target and do not steal addressed commands such as MARA, PUSH YELLOW BUTTON
TAKE MARA, EAT MARA, and KISS MARA remain deliberately authored character responses while PUSH/PULL/DROP/THROW share one dry relocation boundary
PUT MARA IN SACK gets one image-specific joke without making Mara carryable or changing the canonical brown sack
SQUEEZE MARA can trigger one clean offscreen cutaway whose unexplained aftermath is remembered and refuses to become a repeatable interaction loop
JIGS-UP tells Mara about the adventurer's death only when she is physically present to witness it, ends automatic following, and preserves that witnessed history
both Release 1244 schema-3 Mara saves and earlier qualified Release 1245 schema-4 saves migrate into the current state without erasing already witnessed history
ME, MYSELF, SELF, and YOU identify the adventurer as yourself instead of exposing the internal self-object as the noun you
PUT SELF INTO MAILBOX and COMMAND no longer produce article-mangled phrases such as the you, the yourself, or you do not have the you
self-targeted PUT and GIVE commands bypass generic inventory ownership prose before it can describe the adventurer as a possessed object
YELL, SHOUT, and SCREAM accept AT targets including ordinary objects, yourself, and Zork
SPEAK/SAY XYZZY, SAY HAHA, and SAY HELLO parse as spoken utterances instead of unknown-word or malformed-syntax failures
HELP, MOO, and BARK are understood as lightweight natural player commands
KILL MAILBOX rejects fighting a non-actor immediately rather than asking which weapon should be used
DRINK MAILBOX reports that the mailbox is not drinkable instead of anthropomorphizing it as an object that might disagree
MADE is tolerated in natural inspection questions so what is the ground beneath made of no longer dies on an unknown word
multi-action sentences that overflow the legacy two-noun clause model explain how to split actions with a comma or THEN

no actor inventory transfer framework or companion mule behavior
no generic companion combat AI or combat-command framework
no exposed approval, trust, or romance meter
no generic personhood or comedy framework; these paths remain authored Mara behavior
no explicit sexual simulation; the offscreen cutaway remains deliberately unexplained and P-Grue-13
no copied pack, meal, range, nest, actor, troll, rope, room, or sack
no free-form natural-language interpreter layered over the classic parser
no new relationship progression or story train
no test-only production verbs, QA framework, audit hierarchy, TODOs, stubs, or no-op architecture
